details.description: Stored JSON incident payload, not a serde DTO. Fields vary by producer/kind; readers do not deserialize or close this map. Every *_microusd value is a non-null integer micro-USD string (unknown cost is reported in unknown_cost_requests, never as null). Each alerts.rs producer field is typed individually: pending_microusd is sum(held - held_unknown) read from budget_totals with no sign guard (migration 0015 has no >= 0 check), so drifted accounting can make it negative and it is signed; used_microusd (an incident needs used to reach a positive threshold of a positive reference), budget_microusd, spend_amount_microusd and min_spend_microusd (validated positive amounts), and current_microusd, baseline_total_microusd and baseline_hourly_microusd (settled ledger sums, CHECK(actual_microusd >= 0)) are unsigned. Any other *_microusd value from a producer not listed must still be an integer string (signed form). Admission-ceiling identity redaction is constrained by the separate variants below.

info.description: INCOMPLETE contract skeleton (#81 PR1). Access extensions are minimum boundaries, not complete authority. Live owner, role, membership, personal-workspace and object-visibility checks remain authoritative. Personal details are owner-only; platform totals do not grant personal detail access. Shared members see their own activity unless an administrator or the object's visibility permits more; ownership checks can hide objects with 404. Auditor platform authority is read-only, independent User/membership entitlements remain usable. Credential families are exclusive, duplicate Authorization headers are refused, inference keys never authorize management, undeclared routes fail closed, and write scopes do not imply read scopes. BrowserAdminOnly includes Platform Admin even on GET. HEAD implicitly follows GET unless separately declared; no synthetic HEAD operations are listed. Request/response placeholders live in x-omg-request-schema and x-omg-response-schema until actual body presence, status and media types are reviewed; they are not permissive acceptance schemas. No universally enveloped error response is promised.

post.description: Browser-only Anthropic Cost Report v1 evidence. Upload application/json BYTES, not a reserialized JSON Value: page RawValue preserves duplicate keys for server-side typed rejection. Original amounts are decimal cents; conversion residuals are signed fractional micro-USD strings, while amount_microusd is a signed integer string. No invoice verification. Rules the schemas cannot express (parse()): the pages form one chain - every page but the last has has_more=true and a distinct non-empty next_page cursor, the last has has_more=false and next_page=null; buckets are consecutive one-day buckets starting at request.starting_at and ending at request.ending_at, at most request.limit per page; starting_at and ending_at are UTC midnights, the span is at most 31 days, ending_at is not in the future, and exported_at is at or after ending_at and not in the future. Duplicate rows (same bucket and dimensions), non-USD currency and more than 50000 lines are refused. supersedes must name the single latest overlapping import of the same period (409 otherwise); a repeated identical export is returned idempotently. The caps of 31 pages per upload and 31 buckets per page (the schema's maxItems) cannot be isolated from the 31-day span rule by a test: every page must hold at least one bucket (empty pages are refused), so 32 pages or 32 buckets in a page always span more than 31 days and are refused for both reasons. Text limits count UTF-8 bytes (see #405). amount is decimal cents whose whole part is bounded by the i128 micro-USD conversion.

post.description: Requires live Platform Admin write authority AND workspace access; foreign personal executions are hidden. billing_usage is required but nullable; every nested billing counter is required and nullable. Adds evidence to the pinned valuation, never replaces historical prices or silently converts unknown usage to zero. Rules the schemas cannot express: billing_usage must be coherent (BillingUsage::validate, billing.rs): every counter is at most 9223372036854775807; with writes = the sum of the three cache-write parts, writes may not exceed cache_write_input_tokens, and must equal it when all three parts are given; uncached + cache_read + max(writes, cache_write_input_tokens) may not exceed total_input_tokens, and must equal it when uncached, cache_read and cache_write are all given; the sums must fit in i64; input_tokens may not exceed total_input_tokens; input_tokens + output_tokens must fit in i64 (counters up to 9223372036854775807 are accepted with 200 on a priced hold). An incoherent usage, or a token sum past i64, is currently refused with 503 "Reconciliation unavailable" (the usage_values Storage error in src/governance.rs falls through the error mapping of reconcile in src/management/governance/reports.rs), not 400: the contract documents the current behaviour; see #408. meter_usage, output_image_variant and provider_cost_microusd are optional evidence that may be added to an unknown hold, never changed or erased once stored. The hold must be unknown and its execution terminal, the actor a live Platform Admin with workspace access, and the workload not realtime; otherwise 400. Without a complete pinned valuation the request is 409 (for example billing_usage without total_input_tokens on a hold pinned to a version-1 price). Token counters and provider cost are canonical decimal strings in the contract (the handler also tolerates zero-padded forms such as "007").
